whyUs.label: Why Us
whyUs.title: 8 reasons to choose Bus Service
whyUs.subtitle: We have done everything to make your trips comfortable, safe and hassle-free

reasons.title: Reliability & Safety
reasons.desc: Regular maintenance of the entire fleet. All vehicles are insured and inspected before every trip.

reasons.title: Professional Drivers
reasons.desc: 10 to 39 years of experience. Knowledge of local roads, mountain routes and Central Asian border crossings.

reasons.title: Modern Fleet
reasons.desc: Constantly updated vehicles. Buses with A/C, USB charging, Wi-Fi and entertainment systems.

reasons.title: Flexible Rental Terms
reasons.desc: Hourly, daily and long-term rental. Individual approach to every client and route.

reasons.title: Affordable Prices
reasons.desc: Transparent pricing with no hidden fees. Special rates for regular clients and corporate partners.

reasons.title: 24/7 Support
reasons.desc: Round-the-clock dispatch service. We promptly resolve any issues throughout your trip.

reasons.title: Wide Vehicle Selection
reasons.desc: Buses, minibuses, SUVs, VIP cars, minivans. Transport for tourists, corporations and private clients.

reasons.title: Easy Booking
reasons.desc: Submit a request on the site or call us — we will find transport within 5 minutes and confirm your booking.
